messages:
devon: heads up — canary rollout v2.3.1 to us-west started ~15m ago. p95 target 120ms. Observed p95 ~140ms and p99 spikes 350–420ms on a subset of hosts. batching=dynamic, seq dist 32/128. Can we pause and triage? link to logs: https://ci.internal/runs/9243
alyssa: thanks — do we have profiler traces yet? how much traffic is on canary? @sam can you check?
sam: canary is at 5% traffic. i'll pull traces now. what's the deploy id?
devon: deploy id: release/v2.3.1-2026-03-17-1705. affected nodes: us-west-node-a/b/c. perf-bot: dumping current metrics.
perf-bot: automated metrics snapshot — p50=45ms, p95=142ms, p99=378ms, error_rate=0.2%. node-b CPU=92%, GC pause spikes observed.
leo: high CPU on node-b + GC spikes suggests memory churn. which model variant is this? q8_0 or fp16?
devon: q8_0 prod variant. batch_target_tokens=2048, no fallback enabled. suspect kernel allocs or kv-cache thrash.
sam: i'll run a microbenchmark and reproduce with kv-cache toggled. ETA ~10m.
alyssa: proposal: if p95>130ms or p99>300ms we hold the canary. prefer pause now while sam profiles. if we can't get p95<125 within 30m, rollback. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
marco: +1 to pause. i'll prep rollback steps: scale canary to 0, route traffic back to v2.2, invalidate kv caches, and redeploy.
ops-bot: rollback playbook: https://bit.ly/rw-rollback (run playbook -> confirm in thread when done)
sam: microbenchmark finished — with KV cache disabled p95=118ms, p99=210ms. with KV cache on p95=140ms, p99=380ms. looks like kv-cache on certain hosts is causing jitter.
devon: that points to an eviction/hotspot issue on node-b. can we repro with perf harness and collect perf/top?
sam: running perf record + flamegraph now, will upload.
perf-bot: profiling upload complete: flamegraph: https://ci.internal/artifacts/fg-9243.svg
alyssa: updated plan: HOLD canary traffic now. sam to test KV cache config tweaks (reduce segment_size, enable prefetch). if prefetch reduces p95 to <125 and p99 <300 within 30m, we proceed. otherwise execute rollback within 30m. @marco you'll run rollback if triggered.
devon: pausing canary traffic to 0% now and marking the rollout as paused in the dashboard. i'll post follow-ups. thanks all. :thumbsup:
